title: Medication Treatment Line (model)
description: Logical model for representing one line/medication in medication overview.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for MedicationTreatmentLineLM logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for MedicationTreatmentLineLM logical model

identifier.description: Unique business identifier(s) for the medication treatment line

subject.description: The patient for whom the medication treatment line applies

medication[x].description: Medicinal product for which the treatment line refers to. Identification or sufficient description of the product.

@type.description: JSON-LD type reference to ValueSet medication-statement-status

@id.description: Full IRI of the code from ValueSet medication-statement-status

status.description: Status of the record, not the status of the treatment.

version.description: Business version of the treatment line

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the version of the treatment line

treatmentStatus.description: The state of the actual treatment - taking, not taken...

treatmentStatusReasonCode.description: The reason - coded - for the treatment status - i.e. adverse events, refusal...

treatmentStatusReasonText.description: The reason - free text - for the treatment status - i.e. adverse events, refusal...

effectivePeriod.description: The period of time the treatment is in effect

verificationInformation.description: Verification of medication line. The overview is verified as a whole, but each line is equipped with the information. The actual functional meaning and impact of this validation depends on the implementation.

id.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

modifierExtension.description:
May be used to represent additional information that is not part of the basic definition of the element and that modifies the understanding of the element in which it is contained and/or the understanding of the containing element's descendants. Usually modifier elements provide negation or qualification. To make the use of extensions safe and managable, there is a strict set of governance applied to the definition and use of extensions. Though any implementer can define an extension, there is a set of requirements that SHALL be met as part of the definition of the extension. Applications processing a resource are required to check for modifier extensions.

Modifier extensions SHALL NOT change the meaning of any elements on Resource or DomainResource (including cannot change the meaning of modifierExtension itself).

verifier.description: HCP (or device, if authorized) verifying the treatments/overview

verificationTime.description: The date and time when this medication treatment line was verified

category.description: Whatever category for the treatment line. Categorisation of treatment lines is implementation-specific.

medicationTreatment.description: Reference or identifier of the group of lines that belong together

indication.description: Reason why the product has been prescribed to the patient, or why the patient claims to be taking it

indicationText.description: Textual explanation for why the medication has been prescribed or why the patient is taking it. This might not be allowed by some implementations.

intendedUse.description: Intended Use of the medication - prophylaxis, therapy...

usageInstructions.description: Instructions about requested or actual administration of the product. This is repeatable to support complex or concurrent dosage instructions. e.g. take 1 per day for 3 weeks; 2x PRN

preparationInstructions.description: Additional instructions about preparation or dispense

author.description: Author of the comment (Pharmacist, doctor, social carer, patient, device, related person)

substitution.description: Whether and which type of substitution is allowed for this medication treatment line

substitutionType.description: The type of substitution that is allowed.

substitutionTypeReason.description: Coded reason for the substitution requirement

substitutionTypeReasonText.description: Textual reason for the substitution requirement

recordingMetadata.description: Metadata about reporting/authoring of the treatment line

recorder.description: Person entering the statement by initiating a treatment or documenting a statement by a patient or another professional. The recorder may be different from the author.

recordedTime.description: Time of creation of the treatment line

patientReported.description: The treatment line has been documented according to patient's statement

responsibleAuthor.description: HCP who takes the clinical decision for the medication treatment line. If an author is not present, the responsibility of the medication line is with the recorder.

authoringTime.description: The time the clinical decision was made by the responsibleAuthor. Normally, the same time as recording time when it's the same person.

derivedFrom.description: Any data object that this treatment line is derived from

request.description: Prescriptions that have been the source for creating the unverified treatment line

statement.description: Medication-related statements from patients, pharmacists, or other HCPs, that are the source for creating the unverified treatment line

dispensation.description: Related dispensations that are not necessarily related to existing prescriptions/requests/statements.

administration.description: Related administrations that are not necessarily related to existing prescriptions/requests/statements.

other.description: Other related sources of information - CarePlan, Immunizations, Documents (e.g. Discharge letters)...
